en.title: Filling the Margins of Goodbye with You
en.premise: Minato and Nagi are high school twins, but Minato is fighting an incurable illness with his days numbered. Together with a lost AI named Echo, they work to complete a project left behind by their late mother: 'Recording Memories.' Echo, who is not supposed to possess emotions, begins to experience strange 'fluctuations' whenever it touches Minato's fading memories. It was a wordless wish—the last thing a boy tried to grasp while standing on the brink of loss.

zh.title: 与你共谱告别的余白
zh.premise: 高中生双胞胎湊与凪，哥哥湊患有不治之症，生命已进入倒计时。两人与一个迷路的AI“Echo”一起，尝试完成亡母留下的名为“记录记忆”的未竟之作。本不该拥有感情的Echo，每当触碰到湊逐渐消逝的记忆时，便开始出现不可思议的“波动”。那是少年在丧失的深渊中，最后想要抓住的、无法言说的心愿。
